The draft is fine to publish. I checked each sentence.

- **"Peppermint. Just peppermint leaves, nothing else."** This is an ingredients fact, which the policy allows as written.
- **"Cool and clean after a big meal."** This describes how the tea tastes and feels, not an effect on the body. It doesn't mention digestion, bloating or any other function, so it isn't a health claim. If it were reworded to "aids digestion" or "settles your stomach", it would become one.
- **"Certified organic by the Soil Association."** This is on the approved claims list.
- **Tone:** It is short and specific, with no clichés, filler or hype.
- **Labels and pricing:** It makes no price, offer, urgency, review or comparison claims, so none are needed.
